what: Striped geometric lettering — letters are built from circle, half-circle, triangle and square pieces, with each piece filled by thin horizontal lines (line thickness changes from top to bottom of the piece, giving a tonal gradient) to assemble a big heading. Scrub thickens the lines from .55 → 1 while the heading rises from the bottom of the screen to the 40% mark. Loop: scrambled pieces mixed into an empty line panel thicken line by line and come in, turning into their proper letters (3s), then every 5s the lines thin out and vanish (.4s power2.in), thicken into scrambled pieces (.4s power2.out), and return to their proper letters from the top (.5s power2.out, .5s between lines)

options.text: Text (A–Z·0·1·-·. space, lines split with /). If none, aria-label
options.lines: Number of horizontal lines per row, default 34 — original hero 40, footer 22
options.field: Opacity of the baseline on an empty panel (0–1), default 0 — original Hero .22
options.gap: Letter spacing (cells, one line height is 10), default .5
options.intro: loop intro length in seconds, default 3
options.delay: Loop start delay (seconds), default 0 — to start after a loader, use the loader’s length
options.start: scrub ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom

use: — Without a height, it sizes by the text’s proportions
note: The original Hero is a pre-rendered video of this motion (8s, repeating from 3s) — the loop is that video sampled at 0.25s intervals, with the order rebuilt on canvas. Pieces are swapped in random combinations, so frames do not match the original
